0022600167.text: Boston enters at 5-1 on a five-game winning streak, second in the Atlantic and half a game back, while Houston is 6-1 and also second in the Southwest, half a game back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 114-93 Celtics win in Houston on February 4, 2026. Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Reed Sheppard is day-to-day with a back injury and a game-time decision.
